text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
THAWRA
- More countries condemn Turkish invasion of northern Iraq.
- Qatar demands withdrawal of Turkish troops from northern Iraq.
- Iraq informs non-aligned countries of Turkish invasion of northern Iraq.
- U.A.E. says Iraq's absence has led to a strategic vacuum in the Gulf region.
- Iraq accuses Washington of holding up and cancelling 182 contracts under oil-for-food deal.
- U.N. oil overseers praise Iraq's cooperation.
- Measures taken to set up a free trade zone in southern Iraq.
- Ship loaded with cooking oil arrives at Umm Qasr.
- Egyptian women stage campaign in support of Iraqi people.
- Leading Syrian businessman says highway between Iraq and Syria to open soon.
- Culture and information minister receives French delegation.
- Deputy Prime Minister Tareq Aziz receives Russian parliamentary delegation.
(The above were also carried by AL-IRAQ and QADISSIYA)
- Editorial on failure of allied notion of creating a safe haven for Kurds in northern Iraq.
- Commentary on how the United States undermines U.N. integrity.
- Commentary on domestic terror in the U.S..
- Article on agricultural development and its impact on national economy.
QADISSIYA
- Editorial on the leadership qualities of President Saddam Hussein.
- Article on how to boost production in the socialist sector.
- Article says the principles upon which the mother of battles was waged could be taken as an effective weapon in resisting Zionist racist aggression.
